description: M4 (issue #19) read-only KB source scanner for an authorized Magento checkout, one scan kind per payload: magento-platform (KB-1 module inventory from app/etc/config.php 'modules' block ONLY; resolution order app/code -> vendor/composer/installed.json map [v1 array + v2 {packages, packages-dev}, one module.xml read per package] -> vendor candidates/bounded declared-name fallback; version.declared from module.xml attr, version.locked from the composer entry, version.source names the origin; ghost origin is native only for Magento core naming, else third-party), pagebuilder-native (KB-2 per-file content-type declarations: appearance names, license/version metadata), secomm-uiwidget (KB-2 DI component registry records + bounded metadata-only definition parses accepting constructor-default AND named-argument styles, fields via inline array or $this->method() reference; widget.xml counted, never emitted as records) and hyva-ui (KB-2 directory-name census of the licensed package; composer.json is the only package file opened, checkout-root composer.lock consulted once when composer.json carries no version; template/style/script bytes never read). Every open passes the structural baseline deny-list plus caller globs (case-insensitive, full path and basename, evaluated before read) and realpath containment (symlink escapes skipped with LOCATOR_OUT_OF_SCOPE); every opened file is sha256-digested under '<rootAlias>:<relPath>'; denied paths are counted and diagnosed without content; unsupported shapes become UNSUPPORTED_SHAPE + UNKNOWN evidence. The scan request carries {scanId, kind, rootAlias, root (caller-resolved absolute), subPath?, denyGlobs[]}; the declared options set is empty for 1.x — any option key is a scan error payload (UNKNOWN_SCAN_OPTION). Read-only: the process never writes.
